# LAB_SECRET_STORE

A store on the operator's machine that `cata` reads authored secret values from.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `labStore`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.labStore`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

| field | type |
| --- | --- |

| name | string |
| removerCommand | null or list of string |
| vault | record { path, server, version } |
| writable | bool |
| writerCommand | null or list of string |
